paper.title: scMoMaT jointly performs single cell mosaic integration and multi-modal bio-marker detection
paper.version_read: Version of record published 24 January 2023; Europe PMC JATS PMC9873790.1, retrieved 19 October 2026; publisher CDN original Figure1; supplementary information version accompanying article.

figure.scope: Whole original both panels with explicitly attributed Methods explanations; source numeric scatter/score marks represented as disclosed schematic roles, not reconstructed empirical coordinates.

scientific_question: How does a connected mosaic of observed batch/modality matrices share cell and feature factors, then use cluster-conditioned retraining to derive feature scores and marker-based annotation?

semantic_readback.inputs: Four batches by protein/gene/region modalities; P1/P3,G1/G3/G4,R2/R4 observed; five absent matrices are missing, not zero. Same-batch cell factors and same-modality feature factors shared.
semantic_readback.factorization: Generic X cells-by-features approximated by alpha Ccell Sigma CfeatT plus broadcast cell/feature biases. Generic association is distinct from joint effective shared Sigma plus matrix-specific residual Delta alias.
semantic_readback.initial_fit: Initial cell/feature factors are simplex-valued; initial d need not be cluster count. Cell factors feed normalized/pruned neighborhood graph, UMAP and Leiden roles.
semantic_readback.retraining: Cluster labels initialize one-hot cell factors that are held fixed; remaining parameters are retrained. Marker scores Mfeat=Cfeat SigmaT use retrained feature factors and shared association, not matrix-specific residual.
semantic_readback.outputs: Feature embedding, cluster feature scores, top protein/gene/region-or-motif markers and annotation back to cell clusters; six displayed labels are marker groups by cell type, not molecular-marker identities.
semantic_readback.conditions: Connected entity graph required; source-defined pseudo-count bridges support disconnected layouts and may strengthen connected layouts. Initial-versus-retraining dimensions distinguished. Eq1 nonnegative/Eq2 strict-positive simplex boundary retained; no model/score/biological validation run.

design.scope: Editable SVG text/vector primitives, vector PDF and PNG. Actual whole-page/zoom review; no target-journal-width print proof or arbitrary editor roundtrip.
